text: Ride your bike somewhere you've never been.
reason: You'll find a street you'll want to come back to.

text: Watch the sunset from somewhere high.
reason: A hill or a top-floor café counts.

text: Walk a neighborhood you don't know.
reason: Pick a direction and take the first street that looks interesting.

text: Find the oldest tree you can.
reason: Someone planted it before any of this was here.

text: Go for a swim somewhere with a lifeguard.
reason: A public pool counts. Cold water is a good story later.

text: Take the long way home.
reason: The scenic route is usually only ten minutes longer.

text: Find a body of water and sit next to it.
reason: Bring a snack. Stay longer than feels necessary.

text: Get up for the sunrise once this week.
reason: It's worse in theory than in practice.

text: Hike a trail you've never done.
reason: Start small. Finish before dark.

text: Go to a park you've never been to.
reason: Every city has one that's better than the famous one.

text: Walk somewhere you'd normally drive.
reason: You'll notice something you've passed a hundred times.

text: Get up high: a hill, a tower, a long staircase.
reason: The view is the reward and the photo.

text: Find the best puddle after it rains.
reason: Reflections make everything look like a film.

text: Skip stones until you land five in a row.
reason: It takes longer than you think.

text: Fly a kite, or watch somebody else's.
reason: Windy days are made for it.

text: Follow a river or a creek for an hour.
reason: Water always leads somewhere.

text: Watch the planes come in from a public viewing spot.
reason: Bring someone who'll be impressed.

text: Go stargazing somewhere darker than your street.
reason: Twenty minutes out of town makes a difference.

text: Find a bench with a view and keep it for a while.
reason: Nothing to do is the point.

text: Take a bus to the last stop, then walk back a bit.
reason: The end of the line is always interesting.

text: Have breakfast outside.
reason: A coffee on the front step counts.

text: Walk in the rain on purpose.
reason: Dress for it and it's great.

text: Watch the fog burn off from somewhere high.
reason: It's gone by nine. Be there at eight.

text: Catch the golden hour in your own neighborhood.
reason: The light fixes everything for about forty minutes.

text: Go for a run somewhere new, slow enough to look around.
reason: Pace is nobody's business.

text: Pick fruit somewhere it grows.
reason: Orchards, hedgerows, a generous neighbor's tree.

text: Take a dog, yours or a borrowed one, somewhere new.
reason: Dogs are always up for it.

text: Make s'mores with friends.
reason: A backyard fire pit or a camp stove. Marshmallows are not optional.

text: Take a ferry, a tram, or a cable car for no reason.
reason: Transit is a ride if you let it be.

text: Visit a lighthouse, a dam, or a big bridge.
reason: Big infrastructure makes a great photo.

text: Watch the moon rise.
reason: Check the time. It's more punctual than you.

text: Build a snowman, a sandcastle, or a leaf pile. Whichever the season allows.
reason: Whatever's on the ground is the material.

text: Collect something on a walk: shells, leaves, stones. Arrange them.
reason: A small museum of one afternoon.

text: Watch a storm from inside, by a big window.
reason: From indoors it's the best show in town.

text: Go for a night walk somewhere safe and well lit.
reason: Your street is a different place after dark.

text: Find a view of your city you've never seen.
reason: Every hill, bridge and top-floor window is a candidate.

text: Go to the farmers market and buy something you can't name.
reason: Then figure out how to cook it.

text: Cook a dish from a country you've never visited.
reason: Wrong is fine. Delicious is a bonus.

text: Have a picnic somewhere unexpected.
reason: A parking lot at sunset counts.

text: Try the restaurant you always walk past.
reason: It's been waiting.

text: Bake bread, badly if necessary.
reason: The smell alone is worth it.

text: Order the thing on the menu you can't pronounce.
reason: Point at it if you have to.

text: Make a dessert from scratch.
reason: A sundae is the obvious choice. We're not biased.

text: Find the best coffee within walking distance.
reason: Try three. Be scientific about it.

text: Eat somewhere with a view.
reason: Even if the view is just the street.

text: Host a dinner, even a small one.
reason: Two friends and a pot of pasta is a dinner party.

text: Find a bakery you've never been to and buy the strangest thing.
reason: Ask what it is after you've tried it.

text: Cook an entire meal from one market stall.
reason: Constraints make better cooks.

text: Make something your grandparents used to make.
reason: Call them if you need the recipe.

text: Have a long lunch on a weekday.
reason: Taking the hour is the whole thing.

text: Try a food truck or stall you've never ordered from.
reason: The line is usually a good sign.

text: Build the most elaborate sandwich you can.
reason: Take a photo of the cross-section.

text: Make lemonade or iced tea with something from a garden.
reason: Mint, basil, a lemon off a tree. Yours or a friend's.

text: Find the best ice cream in a ten-mile radius.
reason: This is research.

text: Try a cuisine you can't remember ever eating.
reason: There's a place within a few miles.

text: Make pancakes shaped like something.
reason: The first one is always a practice pancake.

text: Have dinner by candlelight at home on a weeknight.
reason: Same food, better evening.

text: Eat at the oldest restaurant in town.
reason: Order whatever they've been making the longest.

text: Go to a night market or a late-night diner.
reason: Pie at eleven is a different pie.

text: Call a friend and go for a walk instead of texting.
reason: Walking makes talking easier.

text: Visit someone you haven't seen in a while.
reason: Bring something from a bakery.

text: Teach someone something you're good at.
reason: Everyone's an expert in something small.

text: Learn something from someone older than you.
reason: A recipe, a knot, a card game.

text: Play a board game that takes too long.
reason: The arguments are the fun part.

text: Take a portrait of a friend they'll actually like.
reason: Good light, a few tries, and let them pick.

text: Play a sport you haven't played since school.
reason: Badly is the expected standard.

text: Go to a free event. A reading, a show, a game.
reason: Something is happening tonight within two miles.

text: Plan a photo day with your friends, on purpose.
reason: Dress up or don't.

text: Invite a neighbor over.
reason: You've nodded at each other long enough.

text: Go to a local game and pick a side.
reason: High school, rec league, anything with a scoreboard.

text: Say yes to the next invitation you get.
reason: Whatever it is.

text: Plan a tiny road trip with whoever's free.
reason: One hour out, lunch, one hour back.

text: Throw a frisbee until one of you is tired.
reason: Ten minutes becomes an hour every time.

text: Go dancing, anywhere there's music.
reason: A kitchen with a speaker qualifies.

text: Watch something at an actual cinema.
reason: Get the big popcorn.

text: Take your parents or grandparents somewhere they've been meaning to go.
reason: They'll mention it for years.

text: Recreate an old photo with the same people.
reason: Same spot, same pose, a few years later.

text: Go to karaoke. Sing badly.
reason: Nobody remembers the good singers.

text: Cook with someone instead of for them.
reason: Two people in a kitchen is a whole evening.

text: Draw something you see every day.
reason: It doesn't have to be good. It has to be looked at.

text: Make something with your hands.
reason: Clay, wood, yarn, dough, anything.

text: Take a photo of the same spot at three different times of day.
reason: The spot doesn't change. The light does.

text: Write a postcard and actually mail it.
reason: The stamp is the hardest part.

text: Build something out of what's in the garage.
reason: A shelf, a birdhouse, a questionable chair.

text: Paint a wall, a pot, a rock.
reason: Color is cheap and it lasts.

text: Rearrange a room.
reason: A new angle on an old room feels like moving.

text: Learn one song on an instrument you don't play.
reason: Three chords is plenty.

text: Press some flowers or leaves.
reason: It takes a week, which is about right.

text: Take ten photos of one color.
reason: You'll start seeing it everywhere.

text: Make a zine, a collage, a mix.
reason: Something you could hand to someone.

text: Thrift an outfit and wear it out the same day.
reason: Commit to the look.

text: Take photos of your street like a tourist would.
reason: Pretend you've never seen it.

text: Start a tiny garden.
reason: A windowsill of herbs counts.

text: Fix something that's been broken for a while.
reason: The before and after is the photo.

text: Make a short film on your phone.
reason: One minute, one idea.

text: Write your name in the air with a flashlight.
reason: Long exposure, steady hands, a friend to press the button.

text: Go sketching somewhere public.
reason: People will peek. Let them.

text: Build the best fort you can, blanket or otherwise.
reason: Then stay in it.

text: Cook from a cookbook you've never opened.
reason: The one with no cracks in the spine.

text: Make a playlist for a walk and take the walk.
reason: Match the songs to the route.

text: Visit a museum you've never been to.
reason: Especially the small weird one.

text: Go to a library and leave with something.
reason: A book, a record, a seed packet.

text: Take a photo of the oldest building in town.
reason: Then find out what it used to be.

text: Explore a part of town you only ever drive through.
reason: Park and walk three blocks.

text: Find the best mural within biking distance.
reason: There are more than you think.

text: Go to a market you've never been to.
reason: Flea, farmers, night, antique.

text: Visit your city's most touristy spot like a tourist.
reason: Take the photo everyone takes.

text: Ride public transit somewhere you've never gotten off.
reason: Pick a stop by its name.

text: Find a shop that's been open for decades and buy something small.
reason: Ask how long they've been there.

text: Go to a botanical garden or a greenhouse.
reason: Warm, green, quiet. Hard to beat.

text: Take a tour of your own city.
reason: You'll learn three things you didn't know.

text: Go to a record shop, a bookshop, a plant shop. Leave with one thing.
reason: One. That's the rule.

text: Find a historical marker and read the whole thing.
reason: Then look around and picture it.

text: Catch a show at a venue you've never been to.
reason: Small rooms are the best rooms.

text: Find the best public view in town.
reason: Observation decks, top-floor cafés and library windows count.

text: Spend an afternoon in the next town over.
reason: Close enough to be easy, far enough to be new.

text: Watch a street performer and tip them.
reason: Stay for the whole set.

text: Visit an animal shelter or a farm. Pet something.
reason: Ask first. Then pet it.

text: Find the best hidden courtyard.
reason: Cities keep their best spots off the main street.

text: Walk a historic street and read every plaque.
reason: Old doors usually have a date somewhere.

text: Go to a pool, a lake, a splash pad. Get wet.
reason: Being a little cold afterward is part of it.

text: Spend an hour somewhere you'd normally rush through.
reason: A station, a square, a lobby.
